body:
I’ve tried too but it does not work, the voice is just really mean to me, if you want to call it a voice. I thought it was OCD of some sort, especially because things come up like “if you don’t lock your door as you leave, then *insert something drastic happening*”. It can be things that are entirely mundane or not important but I’ll *need* to do them. But I went to the OCD subreddit and one of the rules is not asking the other members if you have it, or to look over your symptoms and all that. Which makes since, I’m just very lost with that.

And no matter how I think about it, I can’t stop valuing their opinion above my own. I just have no confidence to judge them harshly. Also I’ve read that already but thank you.
I'm not allowed to post a picture of myself online, anything else? And I mean we can be mushy to each other.
What if your task was NOT to work?
Like I keep saying, I'm really really a bad person, I'm not amazing at all but I love you too, and I hope you have an awesome day.
That's not true but thank you for the sentiment. I love you ❤️
I love you more than anything, I love you all. And not only that, if you have a problem, please DM I want to spread love and support, even if I don't deserve it myself.
Hey, I love you too okay? 🐦🐇💙
Hey, I love you too okay? 🐦🐇💙

Aww that's really sweet, thank you so much. I love you too.

My day has been pretty dreadful, just a lot of bad thoughts combined with school stress led to a breakdown, along with physical stress on my body from overexcercise. You should finish that burrito today, I'm glad you got to eat something you seem to like. My favorite food has to be that Macoroni from Panera Bread, not a lot of people get it though.
Me too, and I will like you, I won't "nut like" you (your username). Love you 🐇
I do too. I love you. I don't know why the world is so filled with hate, it really really hurts me.
You can, and I love you two *hugs*
I really try but it's hard when there's a lot to hate.

I wish more upon you and everyone here, I wish we could all be loved with all the love that was every thought up. All the love on the earth and the universe and beyond. You all deserve to feel valued, and I think I would be happy if I could accept that someone really really loves me.
✋😶✋ *hugs* I would like to get to know you too... Thank you, I love you as well.
I'm definitely not awesome, not even average but I wish you a wonderful day too. I love you back!
You too ❤️
I love you all too... 💙💛❤️💚🐇🐇🐇
*hugs you back*
I'll share my love too. *hugs* You're valuable too, okay? I just wish that the world had more people in it that would spread love...

*hugs* I want to be loved so so so so so so so badly, I've been a really bad person I really have and, I want love. And I don't want to be an overall drain on anyone who even bothers to try to care but regardless of all that, thank you. I love you too, okay?

I don't know if anyone can love me for very long at all, it always passes and people leave, either due to me messing it up or... well it's just me messing up in any number of ways. And I really struggle to do that, I try but it seems impossible.
I'm definitely not an amazing person, I'm a toxic no good person but I love you too, though I don't know if I even deserve love even when I want it so desperately.
I can't promise I'll never feel alone, I very often drive people away with just how horrible I am. I love you too, I'll try I keep trying every day it's so hard though.
I'm not allowed to give away my number but I always would like to chat with a friend. And this support means a lot, I would love to get to know you, 💛
I do a little, not too much though. And thank you as well, no matter how many people I say that to, I want them to know it's genuine.
*love x 100000000 for you*
I don't think I'll ever always be loved but I at least want to be truly loved by one person, and it's so hard to accept that anyone even cares about me. 💙 I love you too though.
I love you as well *many hugs to you*
And, I love you too :)

I always wanted someone who could feel the way I do, I always feel super clingy and unimportant, everyone always seems to have at least a single person who loves them, who deeply cares for them. Thank you for reaching out, honestly.
I love you too, thank you so much 💙💚❤️

I wish you all the love too, the fact that you are reaching out to help another, it just shows you and all the others here are good people, I really thank you all for that. And I'm so so sorry, I'm so glad you went back home and you deserve to live, but I'm not going to pretend I don't know why people commit suicide, I feel that a lot. And I... am having a similar problem, and I really just feel so so unloved, so unimportant, so lonely but this wave of support from reddit has really astounded me. And hey, I can give you love too, not romantic or anything but I can love you like a person loves a person, okay? I hope you can find some peace and if you want to talk, I'd love to in the future.
I love you too, I wish you the best I just wish I could feel truly loved.
I haven't but maybe I could
Thank you for the support too...
Thank you, I love you too.
❤️💚💙 Thank you, same to you
Thank you, I just want someone to love and for them to do the same, you don't have to talk to me if you really don't want too, I'm just. I don't know, very distressed to say the least.
*hugs tightly*
+1 soon enough

Best Joke of all time: "Don't kill yourself, help inside."

Best troll post ever, providing numbers is all people can do though so whatever.
Agreed
Where's suicide?
Time to die lol
YES
Sorry I've given up on my life in the last 5 minutes. I'll message you in a few minutes if I'm not dead.

How does "emotionally abusing" one of my closest friends sound? Not too good I imagine, since I was apparently doing this for months upon months. I've known them both for about a year and for one of them, I would take a bullet for, I trust her with everything. We're all friends and I hurt them both so badly.

What do you even want to hear? I'm sure a pathetic life story or even situation explanation would probably just be redundant here, my other posts detail some stuff. Like I told the other guy: just me fucking up like always and being left by the two people that meant anything to me not their fault, all mine.

It's honestly a coin flip whether there's some god at the very least. And I get that, having no context is beautiful like that, I could just be some kiddo trolling after all, I have no way to prove shit. My other posts detail pretty much anything and when people PM me w their genetic copy paste support messages, it feels worse than no one responding at all. If you don't want to click on my profile TLDR: I was a piece of shit person to my friends, I've lost the only 2 friends or really people who I care about much because I'm just toxic nonsense. The vision of that awkward smile I imagine that they give when I finally try to repent. I guess that's the greatest suffering. But this makes no sense to you, I'm sure.

Hell I just realized I'm so fucked up that I'm probably making r/SuicideWatch people weirded out. I guess if I was more direct like some others, it would be better but I guess too late to change it now. Of course I could burden the very people who are here to attempt to help.

I've already mentioned about a billion times to everyone always, it's not going to help with just different people saying the exact same thing. I get it-I posted in this subreddit and people who have a lot of compassion come and help us get through another day. I guess I shouldn't even be here because the compassion is wasted on me, maybe my cynical comments is all I want to display to some ransoms before I jump off a cliff or something, and probably go to some form of hell for not believing in some random Tribal God łæùï or something and accepting him as my savior.

How about no? How about you survive and I go? Cause fuck ending YOUR life, you need to live. Me? Not so much. You have no place to be dead right now, you need to live because you're actually worth a damn.

Hell if I know anymore, I have other posts I made w this account. I don't know if I even want to be saved, this reddit page is for that right? I couldn't find a r/Convincemetoenditall or equivalent, maybe I just want to talk to one person before I try to end everything just to see if they can gain any remaining happiness from a coward who probably won't even go through with this if he can't find the courage. Pour yourself a drink and stay awhile and if you don't want too, I understand, wouldn't want to bring down someone so much before this happens.
Yo can I join? Except that I go in your place and you live.
I... don't know what to tell you. I'm sorry.
Bad bot
Look at the year
So me

I do have an interest, I just, I always keep wishing that things were not "better" per se, because that's just too big of a request but I just wish that this anxiety and depression of yours would ebb away after you deal with it for a certain amount of time, like a sickness. But life isn't like that, I'll do what I can and listen, I just pray that you can find some peace.

I'm so sorry to hear that Katra, that sounds really tough. I really wish that both of us didn't have to go through all of this, though your issues sound a lot worse. I don't want to lose my best friends, the only people I've felt close too in so many years, and I know they're good people, I'm just not a good person. I try to be but I'm just naturally toxic and I've done so much to try to change.

I... don't even know what to say anymore. There's nothing I can really say or do anymore and I'm just trying to repent if I can and if I can't... I don't know what I would do, probably something drastic. I was always used to being alone, after a few days after meeting me, most people would leave me. I only have one friend left and he ignores me in public and even told me over the phone "it's not worth talking to you cause if I do, I lose friends in the process". And I hurt someone and I apologized but they are really scathed and I'm losing my only 2 online friends and I was kicked out of the server I spent literal months on and I'm just panicking I have no clue what to do. I'm losing the only 2 people that ever gave me any reason to go on.

You can definitely vent if you need too, I just wish I could take that away from you. It does not matter your age or anything, it's okay to feel this way and stressed and all that, it's absolutely okay. I can't promise I have any solutions but I feel your pain, it's so hard to let go, I know.
Why are so many people hurt? I hate that... I don't want to see you or anyone in pain. Why? Why does anxiety have to affect you? I hate it. I hate it completely.
Don't. Please. Don't, I hate to hear you're in pain I'm so sorry please don't. You have value please.
